our_insights: Curiosity-based hooks perform significantly better than generic ones.
Videos with clearly defined beat drops (drop_t) gain higher retention.
The 24-29s range is our sweet spot; anything longer sees a sharp drop-off.
Our 'Why' hooks are resonating well, but need to be paired with higher energy music.
Looping endings are currently underutilized in our library; we need to prioritize seamless transitions.
